mood: hard architectural daylight remains in the far room while a complete dark round tray and three related vessels sit quietly in open shade on a white table

reference_cluster.selection_rule: A6 anchors the plane-specific daylight, dark-tray response and three-item relation; supporting images bound natural wood and neutral-room behavior without supplying runtime pixels

key_light.source: direct back-right daylight crossing the distant room, with the same window providing broad reflected foreground light
key_light.direction: back-right to front-left across the room; the tray receives open shade and broad bounce rather than the direct beam
key_light.relative_size: small apparent sun source on the far plane and a large reflected source over the foreground

ambient_fill: neutral room and white-table bounce opens the foreground glass and ceramic while keeping the dark tray weighted

reference_anchor.role: offline plane-specific daylight, camera, palette and material evidence; a separately sanitized low-frequency scene hint may transport only those measured relationships

fill_contract.source: white table, room surfaces and broad window bounce
fill_contract.color_bias: neutral to faintly cool in shadow with no amber fill

screen_light_map.falloff: bright structured far-room patches fall toward a quieter open-shade foreground without a spotlight boundary around the tray
screen_light_map.gobo_geometry: new hard linear architectural bands remain in the far plane; do not reproduce any reference leaf, heater, furniture or exact window-frame silhouette

specular_contract.highlight_shape: broad interrupted foreground glass edges, rolled ceramic white and a narrow broken satin response on the tray rim
specular_contract.rim_continuity: readable but naturally interrupted by refraction, condensation and viewing angle
specular_contract.transparent_caustic: subtle, local and bounded to physically transparent paths

camera_coupling.support_plane: 45-50mm view stepped back 190-250cm at 30-36 degrees above one white circular table and one complete round tray only 0.44-0.50 of frame width
camera_coupling.shadow_projection: hard 128-154 degree architectural bands remain distant while three compact foreground contacts share that direction with broader edges
camera_coupling.depth_response: tray ellipse, unequal vessel scale, overlap, table edge and light falloff establish depth before far-room softness

color_separation.shadow_neutral: deep neutral brown-gray with a faint cool counterbalance and readable grain
color_separation.material_locality: the #60513D and #312215 wood family stays local to the tray; #BBAB90, #9C8C73 and #DECFB9 remain room and table neutrals while the exact beverage keeps its own color

shadow_contract.edge: hard architectural edges only in the far room; broader environmental falloff and denser compact contacts under every foreground item
shadow_contract.attachment: every vessel or immediate support intersects the tray plane; the adopted glass contacts its saucer and the saucer contacts the tray
shadow_contract.transparent_material: drink-colored transmission stays subtle and local without bleaching the dark tray

contact_shadow.behavior: small dense attached contacts under vessels, carafe and any immediate support

cast_shadow.behavior: restrained overlapping foreground shadows with softer edges than the distant architectural bands

transmitted_light.behavior: bounded beverage-colored lift inside real transparent paths only

capture_contract.hdr: restrained single-exposure response with no automatic lifting of the dark tray or flattening of the far-room sun
capture_contract.white_balance: 4700-5000K warm-neutral daylight with the exact beverage color protected
capture_contract.texture: finite handheld acuity, readable subdued wood and ceramic texture, natural glass optics and faint shared luminance grain
